name: Qwen3 1.7B
note: The smallest of the five, and the fastest on a machine without a usable GPU. Published as Q8_0 rather than a 4-bit quantization, so it is smaller than its parameter count suggests without being a heavily compressed model.

name: Phi-3 mini (4k)
note: Concise by temperament, which suits a two-sentence hourly summary. The 4k context is ample for one hour of activity.

name: Qwen3 4B
note: Strong at following a fixed output shape, which is most of what summarizing a day asks for.

name: Gemma 4 E2B (QAT)
note: Quantization-aware training keeps it close to the full model at this size. The repository also holds a vision projector, which is not downloaded.

name: Gemma 4 E4B (QAT)
note: Noticeably better at summarizing a mixed day than E2B, for half again the memory. The vision projector is not downloaded.
